intro.headline: What we do, _priced._
intro.lede: Data engineering for companies with 20 to 400 pipelines. Ranges come from 61 engagements since 2023; we do not quote a figure we cannot back.

courses.title: Diagnose
courses.note: Two weeks or so. You keep the findings whether or not we do the fixing.

services.name: Pipeline health check
gets: an inventory of every pipeline and its owner
cost by warehouse and by job
the 10 failures most likely to page someone
services.bring: Read-only access to the warehouse and orchestrator, and 2 hours with whoever is on call.
services.skip: You run fewer than 20 pipelines. A senior engineer can do this in a week.

services.name: Cost teardown
gets: a spend report down to the query
3 to 5 changes, each with its saving priced
the changes in a branch you can merge
services.bring: A billing export for 90 days and a reviewer for the branch.
services.skip: Your warehouse bill is under $8,000 a month. The fee would take over a year to pay back.

courses.title: Build
courses.note: Fixed scope, fixed fee and a named lead. A working demo every Thursday.

services.name: Data contracts and tests
gets: contracts for your 15 most-used tables
tests that run in CI
alerts routed to the owning team
a one-page guide for new tables
services.bring: An owner for each table and a staging environment.
services.skip: Nobody will own a table when it breaks. Contracts without owners are paperwork.

services.name: Streaming ingestion
gets: events from app to warehouse in 60 seconds
replay from any hour
a schema registry
a runbook for the on-call
services.bring: An event spec, even a rough one, and cloud access for a sandbox.
services.skip: Your reports are read once a day. Batch is cheaper and nobody will notice the difference.

services.name: Warehouse migration
gets: schema and history moved
every dashboard checked against the old numbers
a 2-week parallel run
a rollback plan
services.bring: A freeze window, and sign-off from finance on the reconciled numbers.
services.skip: The reason is a feature, not a cost or a limit. Features arrive; migrations are hard to undo.

courses.title: Run
courses.note: After a build, or on its own when your team is stretched.

services.name: On-call retainer
gets: a named engineer on your rota 1 week in 4
incident write-ups within 2 working days
a monthly reliability report
services.bring: Pager access and a runbook, even an out-of-date one.
services.skip: You get paged fewer than twice a month. Call us when that changes.

sets.title: Common combinations
sets.note: Totals are the sum of the parts; the time allows for the overlap we plan.

items.name: Move house
items.note: Contracts run alongside the first 4 weeks of the migration.

foot.text: A written scope and a fixed fee within 5 working days of a call.
